instance: SELECT VERSION(), @@version_comment, @@datadir, @@port, @@sql_mode, @@transaction_isolation, @@character_set_server, @@collation_server, CURRENT_USER(); SHOW VARIABLES WHERE Variable_name IN ('bind_address','default_time_zone','system_time_zone','time_zone','innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit','sync_binlog','log_bin','require_secure_transport','restrict_fk_on_non_standard_key');
schema_summary: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_TYPE,COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA IN ('cinema_chain','cinema_chain_test') GROUP BY TABLE_SCHEMA,TABLE_TYPE; SELECT CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA,CONSTRAINT_TYPE,COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA IN ('cinema_chain','cinema_chain_test') GROUP BY CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA,CONSTRAINT_TYPE; SELECT TRIGGER_SCHEMA,COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TRIGGERS WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA IN ('cinema_chain','cinema_chain_test') GROUP BY TRIGGER_SCHEMA;
constraints: SELECT tc.TABLE_SCHEMA,tc.TABLE_NAME,tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE,tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME,COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(k.COLUMN_NAME ORDER BY k.ORDINAL_POSITION),''),COALESCE(MAX(k.REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME),'') FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS tc LEFT JOIN information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE k ON k.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND k.TABLE_NAME=tc.TABLE_NAME AND k.CONSTRAINT_NAME=tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA IN ('cinema_chain','cinema_chain_test') GROUP BY tc.TABLE_SCHEMA,tc.TABLE_NAME,tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE,tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME ORDER BY 1,2,3,4;
